title: Returned-Payment Fee Booking on Rural Home Loans — Payment Operations Desk Reference
content:
A returned-payment fee is owed on a Rural Home Loans loan for a remittance the member's bank sent back unpaid, and it is booked against the returned principal entry of that remittance; one fee arises for each returned remittance, and none when the bank's return reason is unauthorized.

## What booking the fee does

Booking records one returned-payment fee assessment against the returned principal entry named — the entry that reversed the principal share of the remittance the bank sent back — dated today, and adds the amount to the loan's outstanding fees. The fee is then carried on the loan's ledger: it appears in the payment history as a returned-payment fee pointing to that returned entry, and the loan's unpaid fees rise by the amount booked. Nothing is collected here.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `assess_returned_item_fee_25e49e31`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the Country Home loan, as returned by the home loan lookup | identifier |
| `source_ref_id` | the reference number of the returned principal entry of the remittance that came back unpaid, as shown in the loan's payment history | identifier |
| `fee_amount` | the returned-payment fee in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive, the figure already rounded to the cent |

## Return

A dictionary receipt:

- `fee_txn_id` — reference number of the fee entry, a string;
- `source_ref_id` — the returned entry the fee is booked against, a string;
- `amount` — the fee booked, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `fees_due` — the loan's unpaid fees after the booking, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `status` — "booked" when the fee is on the loan.

## Points of reading

- One remittance returned by the bank produces return entries for its interest, principal and escrow shares, but one fee; the fee is booked against the principal return entry.
- A remittance whose return reason is unauthorized carries no fee, so nothing is booked for it.
